info.description: Manage tenants, policies and keys. Served only on the admin port.
info.title: Tollgate Admin API

servers.description: The admin port of this instance

tags.description: What the gateway is doing now, read from the audit trail
tags.name: Live

tags.description: The configuration this instance is running
tags.name: Config

tags.description: The signed audit trail and its sealed batches
tags.name: Audit

tags.description: What each tenant used and spent
tags.name: Usage

get.description: The most recent calls the gateway decided, newest first, each with its guard steps and its outcome once there is one. Taken from the audit trail since this instance started, without prompts, answers or user IDs.

parameters.description: How many calls to return, from 1 to 200
parameters.name: limit

409.description: The audit trail is off, so there is nothing to follow

get.description: The audit mode, the public key the server verifies with and its ID, the number of trail files and the last sealed batch.
get.summary: Show the state of the audit trail

get.description: The most recent sealed batches, newest first, read from the end of the trail.

parameters.description: How many batches to return, from 1 to 200
parameters.name: limit

get.description: The batch's seal and signature, whether the signature and the root check out, and its records' leaf hashes in order. An old batch is found by reading the trail, one such read at a time.

404.description: No such batch in the trail

429.description: Another long read of the trail is running; retry after the Retry-After seconds

get.description: The request's intent and outcome as the trail holds them, each with its inclusion proof and its batch's seal, or unsealed while its batch is still open. An old record is found by reading the trail, one such read at a time.

parameters.description: The request ID, with its attempt suffix for a fallback
parameters.name: id

400.description: The ID is longer than 64 characters

404.description: No audit record for the request

429.description: Another long read of the trail is running; retry after the Retry-After seconds

get.description: Reads every file and checks every seal with the configured public key. One such read at a time.

429.description: Another long read of the trail is running; retry after the Retry-After seconds

get.description: The current period of every tenant with a budget, live from this instance.
The config this instance is running, as a view and not the file: secrets are shown as the variable that holds them, and key hashes, detector patterns and detector terms are left out.

post.description: Reads tollgate.yaml again, validates it and swaps it in atomically. Requests already running finish under the configuration they started with. An invalid file never replaces the running configuration.

200.description: The file was read; changed says whether it differed

409.description: The audit settings changed, which needs a restart

422.description: The file is not a valid configuration

delete.description: Removes the key's entry from tollgate.yaml and swaps the new configuration in. The key gets 401 from then on; calls already running finish. A tenant's last key may be revoked. Needs If-Match with the config version, and TOLLGATE_ADMIN_EDITS=file.

200.description: The version now running, and whether the file changed

409.description: Edits are off, or the change needs a restart

412.description: If-Match is not the running version, or the file is no longer the running one

422.description: The changed file is not a valid configuration

500.description: The file could not be written; nothing changed

get.description: Totals for each 5 seconds, the calls of each tenant, model and provider and the verdicts of each guard over the last 15 minutes, the calls in flight to each provider, the calls refused by a rate limit for each tenant since the start, and the last seal. Counted from the audit trail since this instance started.

parameters.description: How many minutes of 5-second totals to return, from 1 to 60
parameters.name: minutes

409.description: The audit trail is off, so there is nothing to follow

put.description: Rewrites tollgate.yaml and swaps the new configuration in. The guard is named by its policy and its position under guards, from 0, as GET /admin/v1/config lists them. Needs If-Match with the config version, and TOLLGATE_ADMIN_EDITS=file. Asking for the mode the guard already has writes nothing.

200.description: The version now running, and whether the file changed

400.description: The body or the mode is not valid

409.description: Edits are off, or the change needs a restart

412.description: If-Match is not the running version, or the file is no longer the running one

422.description: The changed file is not a valid configuration

500.description: The file could not be written; nothing changed

put.summary: Switch a guard between enforce and monitor

put.description: Rewrites tollgate.yaml with the tenant's budget, in the config's currency, and swaps the new configuration in. It sets a budget on a tenant that had none and replaces one that existed. What is already spent stays counted when only the limit changes; changing the period counts the spend again from the audit trail. Needs If-Match with the config version, and TOLLGATE_ADMIN_EDITS=file.

200.description: The version now running, and whether the file changed

400.description: The body, the limit or the period is not valid

409.description: Edits are off, or the change needs a restart

412.description: If-Match is not the running version, or the file is no longer the running one

422.description: The changed file is not a valid configuration

500.description: The file could not be written; nothing changed

post.description: Makes a key as 'tollgate keys create' does, writes only its id, tenant and hash to tollgate.yaml, and swaps the new configuration in. The key is in this response and nowhere else: it is not logged, not kept and cannot be asked for again. Needs If-Match with the config version, and TOLLGATE_ADMIN_EDITS=file.

409.description: Edits are off, or the change needs a restart

412.description: If-Match is not the running version, or the file is no longer the running one

422.description: The changed file is not a valid configuration

500.description: The file could not be written; nothing changed

post.summary: Create a key for a tenant

get.description: Counts calls, refusals, tokens and cost from the signed audit trail, by the day each request arrived in UTC. Each provider attempt is a call, so a request that fell back to another model counts twice. Dry runs are not counted.

parameters.description: The first day included, such as 2026-11-01. Defaults to the first of this month
parameters.name: from

parameters.description: The first day not included. Defaults to tomorrow
parameters.name: to

parameters.description: tenant, model, key, user or day
parameters.name: by

400.description: A date or grouping is not valid

409.description: The audit trail is off, so there is nothing to sum

changed.description: False when the config already said this; nothing was written

previous.description: The version the edit was made against

version.description: SHA-256 of the configuration now running

key.description: The whole key. It is in this response and nowhere else

previous.description: The version the edit was made against

version.description: SHA-256 of the configuration now running

changed.description: Whether the file differed from the configuration that was running

version.description: SHA-256 of the configuration file now in use
